sources_used.exhibit: Ex-99.1 (Phase 2 LOTUS topline PR) / Ex-99.2 (results deck)

catalyst_rows.raw_text: Achieved positive topline results in Phase 2 LOTUS trial of abdakibart in moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) and plan to advance into a registrational phase 3 program... Avalo paid the former AlmataBio securityholders $2.25 million for an option, exercisable within 90 days of the effective date, to pay $5.125 million... in lieu of the previously disclosed $15 million contingent milestone payment due upon dosing the first patient in a Phase 3 trial of abdakibart.

extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: Tier1 reflects the May 5, 2026 LOTUS Phase 2 topline already reported (HiSCR75 met) and forward plan to advance abdakibart into Phase 3 in HS (no explicit Phase 3 FPI date disclosed; AlmataBio milestone buyout option signals upcoming FPI). 10-K static milestone (Phase 2 topline Q2 2026) now achieved.
